question: United Russia seats in the next Russian legislative election?
resolution_criteria:
Legislative elections are scheduled to be held in Russia in September 2026.

This market will resolve according to the number of seats held by United Russia in the State Duma as a result of the next Russian legislative election.

If results are not known definitively by May 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest bracket.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party in the State Duma.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by Russian government sources such as the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation.
research:
I left out every source dated after the 2026-09-02 cutoff. Several searches turned up articles published after that date, so I did not use them and do not report them here.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on credible reporting of how many of the 450 State Duma seats United Russia wins. If sources disagree, the official results from the Central Election Commission (CEC, cikrf.ru) decide it. No URL is given in the criteria, and there were no results to report before the cutoff.
- Voting runs 2026-09-18 to 20. Nominations closed on 11 July, and documents for candidate registration were due by 5 August. United Russia did not need to collect signatures. [mail.ru explainer](https://vfokuse.mail.ru/articles/69630576-vybory-v-gosdumu-2026/)
- The CEC had certified the lists of all 11 parties by mid-July. [asafov.ru](https://asafov.ru/news/cik-utverdil-kalendarnyi-plan-vyborov-v-gosdumu-ix-sozyva)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-02 nothing is settled. Voting has not started, and the seat count could still land in any bracket.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-24: FOM, the state polling foundation, put United Russia at 33%, down 3 points in a week and its lowest since February 2022. VCIOM, the other state pollster, had 32.7% (down 2.6). These figures count all respondents, including undecided people, so they are not shares of the vote. [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/07/24/fom-zafiksiroval-minimalnyi-reiting-edinoi-rossii-s-nachala-voiny-v-ukraine-news)
- 2026-07-17: Putin's FOM approval rating fell 5 points in one week. [sovanews](https://sovanews.tv/2026/07/17/fom-rejting-putina-upal-na-5-za-odnu-nedelyu/)
- 2026-06-23: Citing Vedomosti, Novaya Gazeta Europe reported that the Kremlin had lowered its targets:
  - a constitutional majority of "more than 300" seats
  - 190 to 210 of the 225 single-member districts
  - a party-list share that might fall slightly below 50%
  - turnout of about 50%
  
  Over spring, Putin's VCIOM approval slipped from 73.3% to about 67.7%. [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/06/23/moskva-snizila-tseli-edinoi-rossii-na-vyborakh-v-gosdumu-eto-proizoshlo-na-fone-padeniia-reitingov-partii-news)
- 2026-03-04: United Russia announced primaries with voters verified through Gosuslugi, the state services portal. Electronic voting in the primaries began 25 May. [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/amp/articles/2026/03/04/edinaia-rossiia-provedet-praimeriz-s-verifikatsiei-izbiratelei-cherez-gosuslugi-news)
- 2025-10-27: Vedomosti reported an internal target of "55% at 55%": 55% of the list vote at 55% turnout. One source said the party should win at least 325 seats. [Vedomosti](https://www.vedomosti.ru/politics/articles/2025/10/27/1150272-nachali-obsuzhdat-rezultat)
- An RTVI article headlined "ER is heading toward 300 seats, SR falls below the threshold" exists. I could not open it (redirect error), so I could not confirm its date or numbers. SR is A Just Russia. [RTVI](https://rtvi.com/news/vybory-v-gosdumu-2026-er-idet-k-300-mandatam-sr-padaet-nizhe-prohodnogo-barera/)

## 4. Base rates
United Russia's past Duma seat totals, out of 450:

| Year | Seats | Note | Bracket in this question |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2007 | 315 | pure party-list system | - |
| 2011 | 238 | pure party-list system | <280 |
| 2016 | 343 | 54.2% of the list vote, 203 single-member districts | 340-354 |
| 2021 | 324 | 49.8% of the list vote, 198 single-member districts | 310-324 |

- 2007 and 2011 are from my background knowledge. The 2021 figures are confirmed in the Vedomosti article above.
- Under the current mixed system, the list share has moved about 4 to 5 points between elections, and the seat total by about 20.
- Each roughly 1 point of list share is worth about 2 to 2.5 list seats. Single-member districts have stayed in a narrow 198 to 203 range.
- If the June targets are met (190 to 210 districts plus a list share just under 50%), that works out to roughly 300 to 330 seats. The October 2025 target of 55% points to 325 or more.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs this exact market, "United Russia seats in the next Russian legislative election?". [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/politics/russia-election)
- An aggregator snapshot from around 2026-07-01 showed 325-339 leading at about 34%, with 340-354 at about 31%. The total traded was about $98K. [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/how-many-seats-will-united-russia-win-in-the-next-russian-legislative-election), [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/how-many-seats-will-united-russia-win-in-the-next-russian-legislative-election/)
- I could not find a price from closer to 2026-09-02.
- Manifold has related markets on whether United Russia gains or loses seats compared with 2021 (324). [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/RealAP/will-united-russia-gain-or-loose-se)
- AI-model "forecasts" in Russian media expected United Russia to keep its majority, but I found no seat numbers in them. [amic.ru](https://www.amic.ru/news/neyroseti-sprognozirovali-itogi-vyborov-v-gosdumu2026-592158)
- I found no expert forecast of seats from before the cutoff. VCIOM's own pre-election forecast was published after the cutoff, so I excluded it.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Final pre-election polls (early September):** the last FOM and VCIOM weekly ratings, and VCIOM's pre-election forecast.
- **Voting, 2026-09-18 to 20:** this includes multi-day voting and online voting (DEG) in many regions.
- **Preliminary CEC results (about 2026-09-21):** these could cross bracket boundaries. Single-member districts are usually where final counts shift a little.
- **Official CEC results:** the CEC usually certifies the final result about 5 to 7 days after the vote, around 2026-09-25, which matches the question's resolution date.
- **Thresholds that could matter:** whether A Just Russia or New People clear the 5% threshold. This changes how list seats are redistributed, and A Just Russia falling below 5% would add list seats to United Russia.
